downstream_contract.target: 83 held-out DafnyBench methods that fail after human annotations are removed
downstream_contract.outcome: percentage verified after at most five greedy annotation-search iterations
downstream_contract.compute_matching: all fine-tuning runs use 1,500 gradient steps

practical_rule: at a fixed DafnyBench fraction, prefer the environment augmented with verifier-filtered DafnySynth annotations

repository_result_audit.interpretation: the pinned result JSONs preserve the same positive direction for every available fraction-matched comparison, although several endpoint values differ from the paper table and the repository does not contain a pure-DafnySynth result file

claim_boundary: fractions within a model reuse one held-out panel and are not independent studies
the experiment concerns two related Llama-family starting models, one Dafny annotation task, and one verifier
the current repository result JSONs and the paper table differ at several endpoints, so both audits are reported separately
verified synthetic augmentation is a measured environment intervention, not a universal claim that synthetic data is always beneficial
